name: WORK STYLING LaLa Terrace Musashikosugi
card: Inside a station-front shopping complex, with company registration available
title: WORK STYLING LaLa Terrace Musashikosugi — a base on the 4th floor of a shopping complex, one minute from Musashikosugi Station
lead: WORK STYLING LaLa Terrace Musashikosugi is on the 4th floor of the LaLa Terrace Musashikosugi shopping complex, a one-minute walk from Musashikosugi Station on the Tokyu Toyoko and Meguro lines. It is a shared office run by Mitsui Fudosan. Everything below is based on the official website.
concept: A workplace inside a shopping building
It sits on the 4th floor of LaLa Terrace Musashikosugi, one minute from the Tokyu station, four minutes from the JR Nambu Line and six from the Yokosuka Line.
The official website lists this site as available for company registration. There is also a plan for unlimited use of a single site, so it can serve as a home base close to where you live.
steps: Inside the entrance is reception, which leads to the work areas.
It is open on weekdays from 8:00 to 21:00.
The open space mixes sofa seats, desks and other kinds of seating.
It suits both solo work and short meetings.
Another part of the open space
Another part of the open space
There are meeting rooms you can choose by headcount.
Enclosed by walls, they suit meetings where you speak up and online calls.
Single-person rooms let you close the door and work.
Each has a desk, chair and monitor for when you need to focus.

word.title: What is company registration?
body: Filing a company's address and other details with the Legal Affairs Bureau so they become part of the public record.
Some shared offices let you register a company at their address. The official website lists this site as available for registration.

The time before or after a Shinkansen ride can be spent working in a meeting room or private room.

name: WeWork Hanzomon PREX North
card: Metal and wood, inspired by the “gate” in Hanzomon
title: WeWork Hanzomon PREX North — an elegant space inspired by a “gate”, one minute from Hanzomon Station
lead: WeWork Hanzomon PREX North is a one-minute walk from Hanzomon subway station, in the business heart of Chiyoda City. Kojimachi Station is four minutes away and Nagatacho Station is also within walking distance, giving access to the Hanzomon, Yurakucho and Namboku lines. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed March 2019 / 13 floors above ground / steel frame
Ceiling height 2,700 mm / 8 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market, rooftop garden
concept: A space inspired by a “gate”
The official website describes an elegant interior combining metal and wood, inspired by the “mon” (gate) in the name Hanzomon — design drawn from the place itself to spark creativity.

A rooftop garden offers somewhere to recharge and meet people between tasks. The building has floors from the 1st to the 13th, and whole-floor use by a single company and customization are also available.
steps: There are eight meeting rooms, plus phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market.
A whole floor for one company
The official website shows a furnished private floor on the 12th floor with its own pantry.
The private office on the 1st floor has direct access from outside the building, so it is described as suitable for uses such as a showroom.
A furnished private floor with its own pantry (12th floor)

word.title: What is a rooftop garden?
body: A garden planted on a building's roof where people can spend time.
Here it is presented as a place to recharge and meet people between tasks.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork Hanzomon PREX North”

name: WeWork Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba
card: At the heart of the Takeshiba smart city, in a “New York × Japanese” space
title: WeWork Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba — linked by deck to Hamamatsucho Station, in a “New York × Japanese” space
lead: WeWork Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba is on the 10th floor of Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba, the building at the centre of the Takeshiba smart city project. Pedestrian decks connect it to JR Hamamatsucho Station and Takeshiba Station on the Yurikamome line, so you can arrive without getting wet. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed May 2020 / 40 floors above ground, 2 below
concept: A “New York × Japanese” design
The official website describes a space themed “New York × Japanese”, designed so you can feel nature and art around you.
The building aims for top-level environmental performance in Japan, and its common areas are presented as open, with garden views.
steps: A space with nature and art
The common area follows the “New York × Japanese” theme.
Ceilings are on the high side, from 2,900 mm to 3,200 mm.
The official website also mentions phone booths and a parents' room.

word.title: What is a smart city?
body: Urban development that uses digital technology and data to make living and working in a district more convenient.
In Takeshiba, this effort is centred on Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba”

name: WeWork KDX Toranomon 1-chome
card: An 11th-floor lounge that flows straight onto an outdoor terrace
title: WeWork KDX Toranomon 1-chome — a lounge joined to an outdoor terrace, three minutes from Toranomon Station
lead: WeWork KDX Toranomon 1-chome is in the KDX Toranomon 1-chome Building, a three-minute walk from Toranomon and Toranomon Hills stations on the Tokyo Metro and five minutes from Kasumigaseki Station. Uchisaiwaicho Station and JR Shimbashi Station are also within walking distance. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed October 2013 / 11 floors above ground, 1 below, 2 rooftop levels
Ceiling height 2,800 mm / 24 meeting rooms / garden terrace, phone booths, parents' room, honesty market
concept: A lounge and terrace in one
The official website describes the main 11th floor as a seamless space where the lounge flows onto an outdoor terrace, comfortable and full of creativity.
The building has enhanced energy-saving performance. It sits close to Shimbashi and Kasumigaseki, next to an area where many large companies are based.
steps: There are 24 meeting rooms, plus phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market.

word.title: What is a garden terrace?
body: An outdoor terrace with planting.
Here the 11th-floor lounge and the outdoor terrace are joined, so you can move between indoors and outdoors as you work.

name: NewWork Ikebukuro 7F
card: 31 seats on the 7th floor of the Oak Ikebukuro Building, four minutes from the East Exit
title: NewWork Ikebukuro 7F — a corporate-membership satellite office on the 7th floor of the Oak Ikebukuro Building, four minutes from the East Exit
lead: NewWork Ikebukuro 7F is on the 7th floor of the Oak Ikebukuro Building, a four-minute walk from the East Exit of Ikebukuro Station. It has 31 open and booth seats, a meeting room for 4 and three single-person seated booths, and the multifunction printer is free to use. It is a corporate-membership satellite shared office run by Tokyu Corporation. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyu Corporation (corporate membership only; no drop-in)
31 seats (open / booth) / 1 meeting room for 4 / 3 seated single-person booths
concept: The upper of two floors in the same building
NewWork has two sites in the Oak Ikebukuro Building, on the 7th and 4th floors. The 7th floor is built around seats — 31 open and booth seats for getting work done.
The multifunction printer is on the 7th floor and free to use. The official page for the 4th-floor site also directs members to use the printer here.
steps: There are 31 seats of two kinds: open and booth.
The printer is free, and there is Wi-Fi, power and phone booths.
There is one meeting room for 4, booked in advance.
It is sized for small meetings.
Three single-person seated booths are available by booking.
To keep using one beyond 120 minutes, you make a new booking.

word.title: What is a satellite shared office?
body: A small workplace away from head office (a satellite office) that several companies use together.
NewWork works on corporate membership: a company joins, and its employees use sites near home or while out.

name: NewWork Ikebukuro 4F
card: Seven private booths and two meeting rooms, a floor made for meetings
title: NewWork Ikebukuro 4F — a satellite office with seven private booths and two meeting rooms on the 4th floor of the Oak Ikebukuro Building
lead: NewWork Ikebukuro 4F is on the 4th floor of the Oak Ikebukuro Building, a four-minute walk from the East Exit of Ikebukuro Station. It has 24 booth seats, meeting rooms for 8 and 6, and seven single-person seated booths, with lockable booths and monitors available. It is a corporate-membership satellite shared office run by Tokyu Corporation. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyu Corporation (corporate membership only; no drop-in)
24 seats (booth) / meeting rooms for 8 ×1 and 6 ×1 / 7 seated single-person booths
concept: A floor centred on meeting rooms and private booths
NewWork Ikebukuro 4F has a different character from the 7th floor of the same building. Its 24 seats are all booths, with meeting rooms for 8 and 6 and seven single-person seated booths.
With lockable booths and monitors, it suits online meetings and somewhat longer discussions. There is no printer on this floor; members use the one on the 7th.
steps: There is Wi-Fi, power and phone booths, along with lockable booths and monitors.
There is one meeting room for 8 and one for 6, both booked in advance.
Seven single-person seated booths are available by booking.
To keep using one beyond 120 minutes, you make a new booking.

word.title: What is a seated private booth?
body: A small single-person room closed off by a door, where you sit to work. It suits online meetings and phone calls.
NewWork Ikebukuro 4F has seven of them.

name: NewWork Omori
card: Eleven private booths on the 6th floor of the Ichigo Omori Building, three minutes from the station
title: NewWork Omori — a corporate-membership satellite office with 11 private booths, three minutes from Omori Station
lead: NewWork Omori is on the 6th floor of the Ichigo Omori Building, a three-minute walk from Omori Station. It has 30 booth seats, a meeting room for 8 and eleven single-person seated booths. It is a corporate-membership satellite shared office run by Tokyu Corporation. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyu Corporation (corporate membership only; no drop-in)
30 seats (booth) / 1 meeting room for 8 / 11 seated single-person booths
concept: A workplace shared by several companies
The official website describes NewWork as a “shared-ride” satellite office for corporate members: several companies join, and their employees share the same sites.
The Omori site stands out for its eleven single-person seated booths. It also has 30 booth seats and a meeting room for 8.
steps: The printer is free, and there is Wi-Fi, power and phone booths.
Eleven single-person seated booths are available by booking.
To keep using one beyond 120 minutes, you make a new booking.
There is one meeting room for 8, booked in advance.

word.title: What is the shared-ride model?
body: An arrangement where several companies use one place together, so each can have a base for less than renting alone.
The official website describes NewWork as a “shared-ride” satellite shared office for corporate members.
